title: Orsen and the Glasshouse
author: Hazel Okonkwo
blurb: Sebastian Nakamura, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
